decision_basis: FAIL: The atomic-claim inventory is stale relative to the current canonical manuscript. It omits the new dekleer1986 citation use, the new expressiveness-gate Limitations paragraph, and the new same-single-author-programme/out-of-programme disclosure sentence.
FAIL: The inventory and AUTHOR_CONFIRMATION_V1.json still bind the author affiliation as Independent Researcher, but candidate_package/MANUSCRIPT.md metadata states affiliation: Stockholm University.

FAIL: The prior preserved terminal-result strings do not appear as exact strings in candidate_package/MANUSCRIPT.md or in extracted reader-PDF text; only semantic prose for several boundaries remains visible.
FAIL under strict checksum-set audit wording: all listed SHA256SUMS entries match and no listed file is missing, but SHA256SUMS itself is an unlisted file in the candidate tree.

The updated manuscript does contain the new expressiveness Limitations paragraph, the new same-programme single-author disclosure sentence, and a dekleer1986 citation; the packaged bibliography resolves all 17 manuscript citation keys, and Crossref verified DOI 10.1016/0004-3702(86)90080-9 for Johan de Kleer, An assumption-based TMS, Artificial Intelligence, 1986.

The candidate review manifest hashes and byte counts match the actual canonical manuscript, claim ledger, reader PDF, atomic inventory, component manifest, and both submission archives; both ZIP archives match their manifest member sets and member hashes with no unsafe member paths.
The claim ledger is byte-identical to the frozen packaged CLAIM_LEDGER_V3.md and retains sha256 6dca07cc8f96557e08228a2dfe5100f4b66e819abf42ee2bbbe9207e095e1f8c.

Delta review found no PROVEN or VERIFIED status-token additions, and limitations were added rather than removed, but the delta adds factual related-work/manuscript assertions that are not covered by the stale inventory.
